Illustrates quite accurately and objectively, the differences between farm and urban family life; and that between the late 19th century and the mid twentieth century. rv: We first start out with a kid's birthday party, the kids look to be about 9-10, terribly informal, outside on the patio, cake is northing special. But they're having a good time. Next is a parade! Fun trying to locate where this was, but I think by that firetruck, we're in Ohio someplace. Pretty standard stuff, Love the flatbed truck full of standing males that stops suddenly. OOF. The parade queen gets crowned right in the middle of it. Huzzah! We then return to the family originally profiled, as the kid plays with his dog (and another dog which I don't think is his).
